We re building the infrastructure for the world s first global financial
computer. Whether you re running a prop trading firm, building the next DeFi
protocol, or pioneering entirely new financial primitives, Helius gives you
the tools to turn ambitious ideas into reality. We don t settle for  good
enough.  We build infrastructure that entire markets depend on. Helius is
Solana s leading infrastructure provider, purpose-built by a Solana-native
team with deep protocol expertise. From high-performance RPC nodes and
transaction sending (Sender) to gRPC streaming (LaserStream), webhooks, and
digital asset APIs   Helius powers teams like Phantom, Jupiter, DFlow,
Coinbase, and Bitwise. Founded in 2022 and backed by Founders Fund, Haun
Ventures, Foundation Capital, and angel investors including Anatoly Yakovenko,
Helius processes billions of daily requests with 99.99% uptime. Build the
future of Solana with Helius.

##

 

Start Building with Helius

Helius provides the infrastructure and APIs you need to build world-class
applications on Solana. From your first API call to scaling to millions of
users, we ve got you covered.

##

 

High-Performance RPC Infrastructure

## Solana RPC Nodes

Lightning-fast RPC nodes. Built for applications where performance matters.

## Gatekeeper (Beta)

Our new edge gateway delivers significantly lower latency. Available now in
public beta.

## Dedicated Nodes

Private infrastructure with no rate limits.

##

 

Specialized Trading Infrastructure

## Sender

Specialized service for traders requiring ultra-low latency transaction
landing.

## Shred Delivery

Raw shreds provide the earliest possible on-chain signals. Delivered via UDP.

Want to try Shred Delivery? Apply for a 2-day trial; we review every
application.

##

 

Real-Time Data Streaming

## LaserStream gRPC

Ultra-low latency data streaming. Get blockchain data faster than anyone else.

## LaserStream WebSocket

Standard Solana subscriptions plus Helius extensions like
`transactionSubscribe`. Battle-tested WebSocket connections for account and
transaction monitoring.

## Webhooks

Custom notifications for on-chain events. Automate your workflows and respond
to transactions instantly.

Want to try LaserStream? Apply for a 2-day trial; we review every application.

##

 

Powerful Solana APIs

## Digital Asset Standard (DAS)

The most comprehensive NFT and token API on Solana. Easily query, search, and
manage digital assets.

## Priority Fee API

Smart fee estimation that saves you money. Set accurate fees based on real-
time network conditions.

## Enhanced Transactions

Rich transaction data with decoded instructions, token transfers, and human-
readable formats.

## Wallet API (Beta)

Get wallet balances, transaction history, transfers, identities, and funding
sources via REST endpoints.

## ZK Compression

Dramatically reduce storage costs with compressed NFTs and tokens.
